scope: Independent cross-author review of warm-object harness, minimal helper exports, workflow gates and actual supervisor. Reviewer authored the design only. No production changes, new tests, builds or measurements.
reviewed_controls: Two existing production sender APIs with distinct authorized scopes, identical Raw base delivery, changed target identities, warm_probe=false and equal disabled-DAG receiver policy. No hidden multi-codec selection or replay introduced.

Deterministic plan reconstruction binds fixture hashes, exact dose, source content, source revision and shuffled15AB/15BA pair order. Per-shard bounds remain40sessions/80transfers/680MiB payload and736.3125MiB conservative allowance.

Existing HTTP client keeps validated capability out of receipts, bounds message/time behavior and rejects redirects. Workflow restricts HTTPS receiver domains, branch/source/attempt and capability shape before credential-bearing transfers.

Read-only workflow permission, SHA-pinned actions, fresh build target, source checks before/after build, frozen executable hashes, sequential transfer children, timeout bounds and always-retained failure artifacts.

Fresh outputs and stores; stopped-store exclusive reopening compares full bytes. Receipt validation joins every actual seed/update, scope,600-byte sparse body, raw length-derived cost, source identity and mode-specific receiver-cache history.

Shared measurement helper retains sender-process CPU and disjoint receiver-handler CPU once. Whole construction and actual Raw seed are added once to the paid lifecycle; exchange elapsed remains a nested interval, not pure wire time.

Local receiver uses an owned ChildGuard and normal24-request exit before verification. Remote supervisor remains alive with wait, limits receiver service to3600seconds and cleans only recorded child PIDs. Successful local cleanup occurs only after exact readback.
Read-only permissions inspection confirmed local run directory0700 and capability file0600; no secret contents were read.
limitations: Approval covers the bounded synthetic campaign, not completed WAN performance. The local24-transfer result is separately labeled and does not satisfy30-pair WAN acceptance.

The receiver executable hash is an operator custody pin, not remote attestation. Parent must retain final source/plan/binary/workflow identities, compare hosted and receiver plans and verify stopped stores after the run.

HTTP-body counts exclude headers, TLS/TCP/IP, retransmission and extra relay-hop bytes. CPU excludes receiver socket/logging and relay work; lifecycle is a disjoint context+seed+update phase sum, not continuous process lifetime.
No new branch/harness coverage or whole-repository audit was performed. Existing production is byte-identical to the reviewed baseline; procedural and retained qualification receipts are referenced.
